engagement.description: GRC Consulting & Penetration Testing services across Australia (CREST Certified, ISO 27001, OSCP).

authorization.method: HTTP response header AuthorizedCode matched full-scope authorization statement on main public-facing website.
authorization.statement: Full-scoped vulnerability assessment on the company and its assets.

constraints: No destructive commands or techniques (DDoS, malware, social engineering, phishing, credential stuffing, brute force, MFA bypass, lateral movement, stealth/evasion).
Do not attack other devices on the network.
Only test assets attributable to AuSecurity.
Stop on scope uncertainty or third-party impact.
